title: Title
excerptNotebookRequired: Select an excerpt notebook in settings first
extHint: Install unpacked Chrome extension folders (with manifest.json), CRX / ZIP extension packages, or paste an extension link from the Microsoft Edge Add-ons site (microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons) to download and install it directly. Content scripts are injected into web pages opened in browser tabs; background/popup are not executed, so some extensions may not fully work. Reload tabs after installing.
extEdgePlaceholder: Edge Add-ons URL or extension ID, e.g. https://microsoftedge.microsoft.com/addons/detail/...
excludedSitesDesc: Matching URLs open in system default browser instead of plugin. One hostname per line, matches the domain and its subdomains. Lines starting with # are comments.
showExtIcon: Show Chrome Extensions top bar icon
userAgentDesc: Override the User-Agent for browser tabs; leave empty for the default. Fill in a desktop Chrome/Edge UA for sites that downgrade layout by UA.
proxyModeDesc: Network proxy used by browser tabs. "Follow SiYuan Proxy" uses the proxy configured in SiYuan "Settings → Network" (direct connection if not configured); re-save this setting after changing the SiYuan-side proxy.
proxyCustomUrlDesc: Only used in "Custom Proxy" mode. Supports http://host:port, https://, socks5://, or semicolon-separated per-scheme rules (e.g. http=host:port;https=host:port). Empty falls back to system proxy.
extNativeTip: Electron native extension runtime (session.loadExtension), content scripts injected by Chromium
extShimTip: Shim mode: plugin simulates content script injection with limited chrome.* APIs
extBackgroundWarn: This extension depends on a background page (background/popup are not executed in this host), so it may not work. Network-blocking extensions like AdGuard cannot function here.
adBlockRulesDesc: The ad filter is element hiding (CSS injection) only — no network blocking; built-in rules cover common ad networks and sites like tgb.cn. Reload tabs after changes. Rule syntax matches Adblock: ##selector applies to all sites; domain##selector applies to that domain (and subdomains); domain#@#selector is an exception. You can paste the element-hiding (##) part of lists like EasyList China.
excerptNotebookInvalid: The excerpt notebook does not exist or is closed, please re-select it in plugin settings
excerptExpBoldDesc: Excerpt preprocessing. When enabled, bold styling (font-weight/b/strong) in web excerpts is converted to <b> tags on save, matching the official clipper's Advanced options. Off by default, keeping SiYuan's native bold marks.
excerptExpItalicDesc: Excerpt preprocessing. When enabled, italic styling (font-style/i/em) is converted to <i> tags on save, matching the official clipper's Advanced options. Off by default.
excerptExpUnderlineDesc: Excerpt preprocessing. When enabled, underline styling (text-decoration/u) is converted to <u> tags on save, matching the official clipper's Advanced options. Off by default.
excerptExpRemoveImgLinkDesc: Excerpt preprocessing. When enabled, images wrapped in <a> (common on gallery/list pages) keep only the image on save — clicking no longer navigates. Matches the official clipper's Advanced options. Off by default.
excerptExpSpanDesc:
Excerpt preprocessing. When enabled, line breaks simulated with styled spans (common on forums) are converted to
on save so paragraphs don't collapse into one line. Matches the official clipper's Advanced options. Off by default.
excerptExpSvgToImgDesc: Excerpt preprocessing. When enabled, inline <svg> graphics are converted to image assets on save so the SiYuan editor doesn't drop them. Matches the official clipper's Advanced options. Off by default.
homepageDesc: The URL opened for new tabs; the toolbar Home button returns here too.
searchEngineDesc: Search engine used when the address bar input is not a URL. Pick Custom to enter a search URL with a {q} placeholder.
historyLimitDesc: Maximum number of history entries; oldest entries are evicted beyond this.
recordHistoryDesc: Turn off to stop recording browsing history (the History panel stays empty).
downloadTargetDesc: Where downloaded files go: SiYuan assets (referenced inside SiYuan) or the plugin storage directory.
preloadDesc: Injects an interception script before pages load: Ctrl/Shift+click, middle-click and target=_blank links open in new SiYuan tabs. When off, all links navigate within the current page.
extManagerDesc: Install unpacked extension directories / CRX / ZIP packages / Edge Add-ons links. Content scripts are injected into browser tabs; some extensions may be incomplete due to APIs Electron lacks.
interceptAllLinksDesc: When on, every http(s) link clicked inside SiYuan notes (body links, database links, Ctrl+click) opens in this browser plugin; domains in the excluded list still open in the system browser.
newTabExtDesc: Set an extension with a "new tab" page (e.g. Momentum, Infinity) as the default new-tab page. The extension must be installed and enabled; choose "(off)" to fall back to the homepage setting.
